stories.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
stories.simple_summary: A company called Crusoe was trying to build a huge computer facility in Wyoming but ran into problems. Google bought the project from them.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and construction companies. There's nothing you need to do, but it shows that building these giant computer buildings is harder and more expensive than people thought.

stories.title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT, just raised 11 billion dollars and is now worth 1.25 trillion dollars. That makes it one of the most valuable companies in the world.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who work in tech. For regular people, it just means OpenAI has lots of money to keep improving ChatGPT and their other AI tools.

stories.title: China reportedly recruited AI exec to spy on Jensen Huang
stories.simple_summary: China's government tried to get someone who works at a computer company to spy on Nvidia and steal information about advanced computer chips.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to governments and big tech companies dealing with security. For a small business owner, it doesn't affect you unless you rely heavily on these companies' products.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is raising 11 billion dollars as part of getting more money from investors. The deal should be finished in the next few weeks.
stories.why_it_matters: This is the same as story 1 above, so it mostly matters to investors. OpenAI will have more money to invest in their AI products.

stories.title: All the latest updates on AI data centers
stories.simple_summary: Big computer buildings that power AI use a lot of electricity and are causing arguments between tech companies and communities. People are fighting about power use and environmental effects.
stories.why_it_matters: This could matter to you later if you live near a data center, as your electricity bills might be affected. Communities are also deciding they want limits on how many more can be built.

stories.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
stories.simple_summary: Hundreds of computers connected to the internet were left unprotected, and someone found hacking tools sitting out there for anyone to access. This was a security mistake.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech companies and security experts. For a small business, the main lesson is to make sure your own computer systems are protected and not left open to the internet by accident.

stories.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
stories.simple_summary: Meta, which owns Facebook, is adding a new feature to its Muse AI assistant. The new feature lets you create custom workspaces that look and work like small apps.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta's AI assistant, you'll soon be able to set it up to look like a personalized app that shows only what you need. For most small business owners, this doesn't change anything unless you already use this tool.

stories.title: Meta’s Muse AI can create custom ‘spaces’ for the version of the app you need right now
stories.simple_summary: Meta's Muse AI tool can now build customized spaces inside the app. You can ask it to create a shopping hub, a game, a music tracker, or other things you need right now.
stories.why_it_matters: This is similar to story 6, so it mainly matters to people already using Meta's AI. For a small business, there's nothing urgent to know.

stories.title: How a Blue Wave midterm might reshape the AI industry
stories.simple_summary: In recent elections, voters in most places said they don't want more giant computer buildings in their communities. This could make it much harder for tech companies to build new ones.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in an area planning to build data centers, this is good news if you were worried about power use or the environment. For most small businesses, this doesn't directly affect you.

stories.title: After the midterms, is the AI industry in for a rough two years?
stories.simple_summary: Voters recently rejected most new proposals for building giant computer facilities. Communities are saying no to more data centers in their areas.
stories.why_it_matters: This is the same as story 8, so it shows communities want more control over where these buildings go. For a typical small business owner, this doesn't require any action.

stories.title: AI is the new dating dealbreaker
stories.simple_summary: The headline says AI is becoming something people care about when choosing to date or be in a relationship. No details are given about what this means.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about personal relationships and social trends. There's nothing you need to do about this.

stories.title: Big Tech lost big in the 2026 election
stories.simple_summary: Voters in recent elections chose Democrats and voted against Big Tech companies. They made it very hard for tech companies to build new data centers.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows voters care about controlling where giant computer buildings are built. For a small business owner, this mainly matters if you live near proposed data center projects.
